long: Shadowrun: Hong Kong - Extended Edition is a 2015 tactical RPG set in the dystopian cyberpunk-fantasy city of Hong Kong. Players build a runner team and progress through a narrative-heavy campaign featuring turn-based combat, hacking, and magic. The Extended Edition adds extra story content and quality-of-life improvements.
name: Shadowrun: Hong Kong — Extended Edition
short: Shadowrun: Hong Kong — Extended Edition (Harebrained Schemes 2015, native Linux, GOG v2.8.0.11)
